Ganesh Idols Immersed Using Cranes and Boats

Authorities in Agar arranged for Ganesh idol immersions at the Parsukhedi pond using boats and cranes. The process was scheduled to continue into the night, with arrangements made for vehicles. In Bhopal, the immersion of Ganesh idols also began, expected to continue late into the night, with 13 cranes and 12 poclain machines deployed for arrangements.
